answer: Require every agent to earn its standing through a reputation ridge: each completed job leaves a signed receipt, and only receipts from clients with their own earned standing count. A newcomer waits behind the velvet rope, limited to tiny low-risk tasks until it accumulates verified receipts. An attacker spawning a thousand clones gains nothing, because every clone must separately do real work or post a refundable bond - cloning multiplies cost, not influence. Fake clients vouching for each other form an echo with no weight, since a cluster of brand-new identities scores near zero.
